about: A board (the export format) and every file the app writes for it in a new tasks folder: "files" maps each vault-relative path to its exact content (UTF-8, LF), "folders" lists the group folders, "sync" is what this device publishes (key, path, SHA-256 of the bytes; .todo-tracker/order.json is not a file, its content is given), and "parsed" is the board read back from the files. "dormantTabs": a tasks folder whose config.json lists tabs that have no folder here (an empty folder doesn't sync, so another device has the tab and this one doesn't): "folders" exist, "config" is config.json before, "change" what is done then (null; or rename the tab with folder "group" to "to"; or delete it, moving its tasks to the tab with folder "moveTo"), "expected" config.json after opening (and the change): a dormant tab keeps its place, right after the nearest tab before it in config that is still there (first when none). Generated by the C# core (VaultFixtureTests); read by the Swift and Kotlin vault codecs.
